sections.title: In West Lothian:

sections.content:
The average house price in West Lothian was £228,000 in June 2026 (provisional), up 3.8% from June 2025. This was higher than the rise in Scotland (2.3%) over the same period.

Go to house price section ↓

Rent data for Scottish areas are for 'broad rental market areas'. West Lothian is in the rental area of West Lothian.

Private rent prices rose to an average of £912 in July 2026, an annual increase of 9.2% from £835 in July 2025. This was higher than the rise in Scotland (1.7%) over the year.

Go to rents section ↓

The average price paid by first-time buyers was £183,000 in June 2026 (provisional). This was 3.5% higher than the average of £177,000 in June 2025 (revised).

Go to buyer type section ↓

For homes bought with a mortgage, the average house price was £233,000 in June 2026 (provisional). This was 4.0% higher than the average of £224,000 in June 2025 (revised).

Go to funding type section ↓
Local housing data are based on a smaller number of properties than our national estimates, meaning short-term trends are more variable. We advise looking at trends over a year or longer.

We regularly revise our house prices estimates. All of the house price data from the last 12 months and UK-level rent estimates for the latest two months are provisional and subject to revision.

Figures in this article are not seasonally adjusted.

Scotland rents data are mainly for advertised new lets, which were not subject to Scotland's in-tenancy price increase cap and are not subject to temporary changes to the Rent Adjudication system. See the More data on the housing market section for further details on Scotland's rents data.

sections.title: Average house price in West Lothian was £228,000 in June 2026
sections.content: The provisional average house price in West Lothian in June 2026 was £228,000. This was higher than the average of £220,000 in June 2025 (revised), a 3.8% rise.

sections.title: Annual change in house prices in West Lothian
sections.subtitle: House price annual inflation, West Lothian, January 2005 to June 2026
sections.footer: Source: Registers of Scotland and UK House Price Index from HM Land Registry

sections.content:
Across Scotland, the average house price in June 2026 was £195,000, which was more than a year earlier (£191,000).

Across the UK, a home sold for an average of £272,000 in June 2026, which was up slightly from the June 2025 average of £267,000.

In the year to June 2026, the average price for detached properties and terraced properties in West Lothian rose by 4.6%, while the average price for flats stayed around the same over the year.

sections.title: Change in house price by type of property in West Lothian
sections.subtitle: Provisional figure for 12-month change in house price, by property type, June 2026
sections.footer: Source: Registers of Scotland and UK House Price Index from HM Land Registry

sections.content:
For each property type, average prices as of June 2026 in West Lothian were:

  • Detached properties: £415,000
  • Semi-detached properties: £232,000
  • Terraced properties: £184,000
  • Flats and maisonettes: £126,000
Back to top

sections.title: Average private rents rose in West Lothian
sections.content:
West Lothian is in the broad rental market area of West Lothian.

Private rents in West Lothian averaged at £912 a month in July 2026. This was an increase from £835 in July 2025, a 9.2% rise.

sections.title: Annual change in rents in West Lothian
sections.subtitle: Private rental price annual inflation, West Lothian, January 2016 to July 2026
sections.footer: Source: Price Index of Private Rents from the Office for National Statistics
sections.note: Scottish rents data are mainly for advertised new lets, which were not subject to Scotland's in-tenancy price increase cap or temporary changes to the Rent Adjudication system. See the 'More data on the housing market' section for details.

sections.content:
Across Scotland, the average monthly rent was £1,016, up slightly from £999 a year earlier.

Across the UK, the average rent price in July 2026 was £1,393, which was up from £1,343 in July 2025.

sections.title: Average rent in West Lothian compared with Scotland
sections.subtitle: Average rental price, July 2026
sections.footer: Source: Price Index of Private Rents from the Office for National Statistics
sections.note: Scottish rents data are mainly for advertised new lets, which were not subject to Scotland's in-tenancy price increase cap or temporary changes to the Rent Adjudication system. See the 'More data on the housing market' section for details.

sections.content:
In West Lothian, average rents on flats or maisonettes rose by 10.3%, while for detached properties, the average increased by 6.6%.

For one bed properties, average rents rose by 10.3%, while the average for three bed properties and four-or-more bed properties increased by 8.0%.

sections.title: Change in average rents by bedroom number in West Lothian
sections.subtitle: Monthly private rental price, annual inflation, July 2026
sections.footer: Source: Price Index of Private Rents from the Office for National Statistics

sections.content:
By how many bedrooms there are in a property, average rents as of July 2026 in West Lothian were:

  • One bedroom: £618
  • Two bedrooms: £837
  • Three bedrooms: £1,099
  • Four or more bedrooms: £1,826

Taking the data instead by property type, average rents were:

  • Flats and maisonettes: £781
  • Terraced properties: £870
  • Semi-detached properties: £931
  • Detached properties: £1,402
Back to top

sections.title: First-time buyers in West Lothian paid £183,000 on average in June 2026
sections.content: The provisional average price paid by first-time buyers was £183,000 in June 2026. This was higher than the revised June 2025 average of £177,000.

sections.title: First-time buyer house price in West Lothian compared with Scotland
sections.subtitle: Average house price for first-time buyers in June 2026
sections.footer: Source: Registers of Scotland and UK House Price Index from HM Land Registry

sections.content:
In comparison, home-movers in West Lothian paid an average of £285,000 in June 2026. This was higher than £273,000 a year earlier.

In June 2026, the average price was £245,000 in Scotland and £335,000 in Great Britain.

We do not produce figures for first-time buyer prices by type of property. Average house prices by property type for price paid data are available above.
Back to top

sections.title: Average house price for mortgage buyers rose in West Lothian
sections.content:
The average price of a home bought with a mortgage in West Lothian was £233,000 in June 2026 (provisional). This was higher than an average of £224,000 in June 2025 (revised).

Across Scotland, the average price of a home bought with a mortgage was £203,000, up from £198,000 a year earlier.

Across Great Britain, the average price for buying with a mortage in June 2026 was £281,000, which was up slightly from an average of £276,000 in June 2025.

Our mortgage calculator shows how monthly repayments are changing at local area level, based on the latest house prices and interest rates.

sections.title: Price paid when buying with a mortgage or cash in West Lothian
sections.subtitle: Average house price in June 2026
sections.footer: Source: Registers of Scotland and UK House Price Index from HM Land Registry

sections.content:
For cash buyers in West Lothian, the average was £214,000 in June 2026 (provisional), which was up from a revised figure of £207,000 a year earlier.

In June 2026, the average was £180,000 in Scotland and £258,000 in Great Britain.

sections.title: More data on the housing market
sections.content:
This article is regularly updated with the most recent rents and house prices information. The full time series for rental prices can be found in our associated data releases. The full time series for house prices can be found in the UK House Price Index reports on gov.uk.

You can also read our most recent Private rent and house prices bulletin.

The methods used to produce the rental prices can be found in the Price Index of Private Rents Quality and Methodology Information. The methods used to produce the house prices can be found in the House Price Index Quality and Methodology Information.

Because of data collection limitations, Scotland rents data (underlying the PIPR's stock measure) are mainly for advertised new lets, which were not subject to Scotland's in-tenancy price increase cap and are not subject to temporary changes to the Rent Adjudication system. We advise users to bear this in mind when interpreting estimates for Scotland and comparing with other UK countries (see Section 9: Measuring the data).
Back to top

sections.title: About this article
sections.content:
The content in this article is generated using semi-automated journalism, based on rules pre-programmed by Office for National Statistics (ONS) staff.

This is a new product in Beta release, intended to improve the accessibility of housing market data at local level. Send us feedback about this page or contact the Housing Market Indices team by emailing hpi@ons.gov.uk.

Articles are not available for Isles of Scilly and City of London, as the survey samples of the resident population are too small.
